files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Compatibility
- Nextcloud 36.

### Translations
- German, informal (de) and formal (de_DE).
- French: "albums never played at all" was translated as if it meant albums never played in full.

### Settings
- "Delete my history…" is a button with text, under "Stop tracking" in the Tracking section; the History section is renamed Export. Sections are separated by a line.

### About
- New screen in the navigation, moved out of the settings: version, and links to the source code, the issues, what's new (this changelog) and the licence on Codeberg.
- An invitation to leave a review on the Nextcloud app store, and a Buy Me a Coffee link to support the author.
